cases.sentence: Павел созвал учеников, ободрил их, попрощался и отправился в ___.
cases.translation: Paul summoned the disciples, encouraged them, said goodbye, and left for Macedonia.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with motion requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Проходя через разные области, Павел многими словами ободрял ___.
cases.translation: Passing through various regions, Paul encouraged the believers with many words.
cases.explain: After the quantifier 'многими' the genitive plural is used with the transitive verb ободрял.

cases.sentence: В верхней комнате, где мы собрались, горело много ___.
cases.translation: In the upper room where we gathered, there were many lamps.
cases.explain: After 'много' (many), the genitive plural form is required.

cases.sentence: На окне сидел молодой человек по имени ___.
cases.translation: A young man named Eutychus sat in the window.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the subject of сидел (sat).

cases.sentence: Евтих упал на землю с третьего ___.
cases.translation: Eutychus fell to the ground from the third floor.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Павел спустился, лег сверху на молодого человека и обнял ___.
cases.translation: Paul went down, lay on top of the young man and embraced him.
cases.explain: The transitive verb обнял (embraced) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я со смирением и слезами служил ___, несмотря на все испытания.
cases.translation: I served the Lord with humility and with tears, despite all the trials.
cases.explain: The verb служил (served) requires the dative case for its indirect object.

cases.sentence: Я не упускал ничего из того, что было бы полезно вам, уча вас по ___.
cases.translation: I didn't shrink from declaring anything that was profitable, teaching you from house to house.
cases.explain: The preposition по (through/according to) with 'по домам' (from house to house) requires the dative.

reading.ru: Когда беспорядки утихли, Павел созвал учеников, ободрил их, попрощался и отправился в Македонию.
reading.question: What did Paul do after the uproar in Ephesus had ceased?
options: He called the disciples, encouraged them, said goodbye, and left for Macedonia
He stayed in Ephesus and continued preaching
He sent others ahead while he stayed behind
reading.correct: He called the disciples, encouraged them, said goodbye, and left for Macedonia
reading.explain: The text states 'Павел созвал учеников, ободрил их, попрощался и отправился в Македонию' — Paul summoned disciples, encouraged them, took leave and went to Macedonia.

reading.ru: На окне сидел молодой человек по имени Евтих. Поскольку Павел долго говорил, Евтих погрузился в глубокий сон и упал на землю с третьего этажа.
reading.question: What happened to Eutychus while Paul was speaking?
options: He fell asleep and fell from the third floor to the ground
He listened attentively and took notes
He became angry and left the room
He was healed by Paul's touch
reading.correct: He fell asleep and fell from the third floor to the ground
reading.explain: The text says 'Евтих погрузился в глубокий сон и упал на землю с третьего этажа' — Eutychus was overwhelmed with sleep and fell from the third floor.

reading.ru: Павел спустился, лег сверху на молодого человека и обнял его. «Не волнуйтесь», — сказал он, — «он жив».
reading.question: How did Paul respond after Eutychus fell?
options: He went down, lay on the young man, embraced him, and said 'Don't be troubled, for his life is in him'
He called for a doctor immediately
He told the people to continue the meeting
He left the room in shock
reading.correct: He went down, lay on the young man, embraced him, and said 'Don't be troubled, for his life is in him'
reading.explain: The text describes Paul's action: 'спустился, лег сверху на молодого человека и обнял его' and his words 'он жив' — he is alive.

reading.ru: Я со смирением и слезами служил Господу, несмотря на все испытания, через которые мне пришлось пройти из-за заговоров иудеев.
reading.question: How did Paul describe his service to the Lord in Asia?
options: With humility and tears, despite trials and Jewish plots
reading.correct: With humility and tears, despite trials and Jewish plots
reading.explain: Paul said 'Я со смирением и слезами служил Господу, несмотря на все испытания' — I served the Lord with humility and tears despite all trials.

reading.ru: Сейчас же я, понуждаемый духом, иду в Иерусалим, не зная, что там со мной будет.
reading.question: What did Paul say about going to Jerusalem?
options: He was compelled by the Spirit to go, not knowing what would happen to him
He wanted to visit the Temple with his friends
He was ordered by the Roman authorities
He was going to rest and vacation
reading.correct: He was compelled by the Spirit to go, not knowing what would happen to him
reading.explain: The text states 'я, понуждаемый духом, иду в Иерусалим, не зная, что там со мной будет' — I am going to Jerusalem, compelled by the Spirit, not knowing what will happen.

reading.ru: Помня слова Господа Иисуса, «блажение давать, чем принимать».
reading.question: What teaching of Jesus did Paul recall for the Ephesian elders?
options: It is more blessed to give than to receive
Blessed are the poor in spirit
reading.correct: It is more blessed to give than to receive
reading.explain: Paul quoted the Lord's words: 'блажение давать, чем принимать' — 'It is more blessed to give than to receive.'
